name: Req0002MergePullRequestUserPullRequestCondition
rationale: This condition encodes exactly the requirement that merging a pull request requires the user to hold the maintainer role, not be the author, and be using VPN, per the source text.
plain_english_summary: A user may merge a pull request only if they have the maintainer role, are not the author of the pull request, and are connected to the VPN.
source_excerpt: [source_id: src.root.p0002.l3] A user may merge a pull request only if the user holds the maintainer role, is not the pull request’s author, and is using the VPN.
symbolic_verification_log: match-vacuity: ok (policy match condition is reachable)

name: Req0003MergePullRequestUserPullRequestCondition
rationale: Encode the specific requirement that the pull request being merged must have at least one approval (approvalCount >= 1) and the target branch name must start with 'hotfix/'. This condition complements the previously approved conditions (maintainer role, not author, VPN usage) without repeating them.
plain_english_summary: The pull request must have at least one approval and its target branch name must begin with "hotfix/".
source_excerpt: [source_id: src.root.p0003.l3] The pull request must have at least one approval, and its target branch name must begin with “hotfix/”.
reference_cedar: permit(principal is User, action == Action::"mergePullRequest", resource is PullRequest) when { resource.approvalCount >= 1 && resource.targetBranch like "hotfix/*" };
symbolic_verification_log: match-vacuity: ok (policy match condition is reachable)
